description: Constant baseline: always predict '1' (majority-ish class, ~66% of pool pairs are paraphrases).
4 layers, 1 head, d=230. Prev-char shift heads (2) build trigram keys; layer 3 counts sink-gated trigram matches of each s2 char vs s1; layer 4 averages over s2; threshold 0.5 of the slope.
Same trigram circuit as TrigramSinkV1, threshold THETA=0.31 (tuned on seed-1 sample): predict 1 iff >=31% of s2 trigrams occur in s1.
